catalog_source: IEK AIR56B2 catalog data confirmed by the operator as the intended motor variant; instance nameplate photo and hash are not yet attached
measurement_note: This profile is a provisional MCSDK ACIM V/F open-loop candidate. The physical motor is intended to be connected in Delta to a 220 V line-to-line inverter. MCSDK uses the star-equivalent 127.017 V phase-to-neutral model. Rs/Rr/Lls/Llr/Lm/inertia are intentionally absent: they must be measured before FOC/identification or any high-voltage release.
